column7: ValidateMachineToken (ADR-030) and ValidateOIDCToken (ADR-031) soft-failed a GetMachineRoles storage error into (machine, []string{}, nil) -- a successful-looking validation with an EMPTY role list, the exact fail-open #1944 removed from ValidatePATToken/ValidateSessionToken and which both machine paths were missed by. Not a privilege gain (zero roles only ever fails closed at core.Authorize) but a silent wrong answer the HTTP middleware then POSITIVELY CACHED as UserContext.Roles, and a machine-token cache HIT refreshes only the credential's restriction/revocation state, never its roles -- so one blip stripped a machine identity of every grant for the rest of validTokenTTL, reporting success throughout. Fixed by returning the existing ErrRoleResolutionUnavailable sentinel from both, plus mapping it to codes.Unavailable in validateGRPCMachineToken, which previously collapsed every ValidateMachineToken error into Unauthenticated + a peer-IP brute-force strike. Found by FIX-1's sibling sweep for #2548/#2567
